## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Oct 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Gmaloy_, Oct 3, 2026, 1/5: "Your format for the State Farm ad freezes the screen each time I’m attempting to log my food. Is that really necessary. I already purchasedState Farm insurance, and this setup makes me wish I hadn’t"
            2. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
            3. _Anne Dlh_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "The application bugs from the first use. I do not recommend that you use an application that tells you to consume only 1400 kCal per day for a woman... You will obtain the opposite of your objective. You will disrupt your body and your mental health. And for some, developing TCA… Nice try but no thanks."
